g.title: j2091808238
g.text: quincy said u wanted to talk to me? <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>

g.title: j1230119873
g.text: I just wanted to say I was sorry. I know I screwed up really badly with you.

g.title: j61008881
g.text: Yeah. I. I don't know how else to say this, but I - I have feelings for you.

g.title: j4074556995
g.text: oh. do u really mean that?

g.title: j4164565489
g.text: I really do. I've been losing sleep over it, honestly. :{

g.title: j1224084797
g.text: um. i mean. u did have ur chance and it didn't go so well. <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>

g.title: j2575700771
g.text: really??? <RETRO_EMOJI_WUT> why didn't u say anything?

g.title: j771532
g.text: but... if i'm being honest i have really missed u... and quincy did say u were really sorry...

g.title: j2135345723
g.text: I guess I was scared to.

g.title: j332549703
g.text: are u sure you want to give this another try?

g.title: j2806120003
g.text: lol u are so strange sometimes <RETRO_EMOJI_SHRUG>

g.title: j2747000214
g.text: and honestly? u've been on my mind a lot, lately... are u sure you want to go out with me?

g.title: j1025542577
g.text: are u sure you want to go out with me?
